correctness.rationale: The entire phase-dependent Schatten-fourth trace is computed from exact 4x4 Gram entries; the winding coefficient is 2B times the product of edge weights. The reduction to parity sums u,v and geometric pair products p,q is onto a product rectangle for every u. For beta<2, its Hessian has eigenvalues -4A +/-2B<0, so each minimizer must occur at a corner. Three corner classes reduce to explicit quadratic scalar minimizations. Branch-difference identities give beta=1/2 and beta=1; strictness proves full optimizer classification including coexistence. At beta=2 the identity F/A=1-2(p-q)^2 provides the complete endpoint proof. A standalone standard-library exact Fraction checker executed 648 exact 4x4 matrix trace identities, rational branch comparisons and finite-grid tests. Numerical optimization also agreed; finite tests are only diagnostics.
